text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD-acc_ingest-003 - metering.pipeline.delay (severity: high) for service=usage-ingest-consumer. Count delay > 12m, consumer lag growing. link: https://pagerduty.example/pd/PD-acc_ingest-003

pd-bot: Incident created and notified on-call: Olivia Chen (primary), Tim Nguyen (secondary). Auto-escalation in 6m.

Olivia Chen: acked and taking. I'm coming in on call. what is the immediate customer impact? :eyes:

Jordan Patel: seeing consistent downstream checkpoint lag. shards 7/12 report > 10k messages behind. token counts are not being committed to ledger. potential invoice risk for yesterday's batch. logs:
```
consumer_proc[shard-07] ERROR commit_checkpoint failed: Timeout(/socket) after 30s
ingest.metrics.delay_ms = 724000
last_commit_offset = 18239421, current_offset = 18249412
```

Miguel Torres: queue growth on kafka topic usage-events-raw -> lag rate ~ 2k/min. autoscaler didn't spin up extra consumers, looks like consumer group stalled (heartbeat failing). seeing frequent GC pauses on consumer nodes.

Olivia Chen: immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause exports to billing reconciliation to avoid generating partial invoices; 2) scale up consumer fleet by hand (spawn 4), 3) trigger consumer restart for shards showing commit timeouts, 4) open invoice hold for affected accounts. Sara, can you flag ledger?

Sara Li: flagged invoice-hold for accounts with ingestion timestamp 2026-03-13 00:00:00 - 2026-03-13 23:59:59. Created ticket BILL-HOLD-472. Notifying finance ops.

Tim Nguyen: running an automated restart on nodes with high GC now: `./ops/restart_consumer.sh --shard 07,08,09,10`. Will watch rejoin.

Jordan Patel: small patch in consumer lib in last deploy exposed a rare deadlock under backpressure. rolling back that PR on canary first. PR: github.com/redwood/ingest/commit/ab12cd3

Amy Park: calling out customers with active invoices impacted: acme-inc, fast-saas, studyapp. Notifying CSMs to prepare comms. Amy -> I'll draft an explainer.

pd-bot: PagerDuty acknowledgement recorded by Olivia Chen at 2475123478

Olivia Chen: update — restarted shard 07 and 08 consumers, both rejoined consumer group and started committing offsets. Observed commit latencies drop from ~30s to ~120ms.

Miguel Torres: GC config tune applied (`-XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200`) on the restarted nodes. New nodes spawned and joined. Lag trend reversing. kafka lag graph: https://grafana.redwood/graph?panel=lag-usage

Jordan Patel: rollback of recent PR initiated on canary, patch removed. Canary processing looks healthy. Scheduling rollout to remaining consumers if canary holds for 10m.

Olivia Chen: customer impact assessment: affected window approx 2026-03-13T18:10:00Z - 2026-03-13T18:56:00Z. Estimated missing token count = ~1.2M tokens uncommitted. Finance: this could under-report usage if not reconciled.

Sara Li: ledger backfill job queued (backfill-job-889). We'll reprocess raw topic for affected offsets once consumers are stable. ETA for backfill completion ~ 3 hours (depends on cluster throughput).

Amy Park: CSMs notified. Standard customer note drafted and ready to send once we have final reconciliation numbers.

Tim Nguyen: monitoring: set temporary alert threshold lower to catch commit timeouts earlier, and added a short-term runbook step to restart on GC spikes. Also increased consumer autoscaler sensitivity.

Olivia Chen: status — incident in mitigation. No active page escalation. I'll hand off to Tim for overnight watch at 2475123600.

Tim Nguyen: ack and taking watch. I'll monitor backfill progress and ledger reconciliation. please post any new observations here. :thumbsup:

pd-bot: PagerDuty incident resolved (auto-close) at 2475123799 — no further escalation required.

Olivia Chen: postmortem note: root cause likely consumer-side GC/backpressure interacting with a recent consumer lib change causing heartbeat/commit stalls. Actions: 1) revert faulty PR + add integration test for heavy backpressure, 2) improve consumer GC defaults and autoscaler sensitivity, 3) add end-to-end billing reconciliation smoke test and alert for token count drift, 4) run a dry-run of backfill process in staging. Owners assigned in follow-up doc.

Jordan Patel: +1 on tests. I'll own integration test and rollback verification.

Sara Li: finance ops will validate invoices once backfill completes and coordinate any credits if needed.

Miguel Torres: putting dashboard panels in a shared workspace for on-call visibility.

Amy Park: final note — CSM outreach scheduled after reconciliation. Great coordinated response team.

( thread end )
